links.outcome: Chatbot identification of potential safety concerns in interaction transcripts
links.effect: Amanda did not consistently identify potential safety concerns; authors call for enhanced risk detection capabilities before real-world deployment.
links.quote: However, limitations were noted: Amanda occasionally produced repetitive or generic responses and did not consistently identify potential safety concerns.

unlisted_practices: Single-session LLM chatbot relationship intervention compared with an evidence-based writing task on relationship satisfaction and communication outcomes

screen.reason: This is an empirical randomized controlled trial evaluating a GPT-4-based mental health/relationship support chatbot with real human participants. It tests the intervention against an active control rather than testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
